mapper.sql: turn_id, account_id, question_id, request_id, prompt, status, file_ref, request_hash, answer_markdown, failure_code, failure_message, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM tutor_turn WHERE AND turn_id = #{turnId}
SELECT account_id FROM app_user WHERE account_id = #{accountId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM tutor_turn WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND request_id = #{requestId}
SELECT FROM tutor_turn WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND status IN ('WAITING_ANSWER', 'GENERATING')
SELECT FROM ( SELECT FROM tutor_turn WHERE ORDER BY created_at DESC, turn_id DESC LIMIT 50 ) recent ORDER BY created_at, turn_id

INSERT INTO tutor_turn(turn_id, account_id, question_id, request_id, prompt, status) VALUES (#{turn.turnId}, #{turn.accountId}, #{turn.questionId}, #{turn.requestId}, #{turn.prompt}, 'WAITING_ANSWER') RETURNING
mapper.update: UPDATE tutor_turn SET file_ref = #{fileRef}, request_hash = #{hash}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE AND turn_id = #{turnId} AND status = 'WAITING_ANSWER'

UPDATE tutor_turn SET status = 'GENERATING', answer_markdown = NULL, failure_code = NULL, failure_message = NULL, updated_at = clock_timestamp() WHERE AND turn_id = #{turnId} AND status = #{status} AND file_ref IS NOT NULL AND (failure_code IS NULL OR failure_code NOT IN ('TABLET_CANCELLED', 'GENERATION_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN'))

UPDATE tutor_turn SET status = #{status}, answer_markdown = #{answer,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, failure_code = #{failureCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, failure_message = #{failureMessage,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE AND turn_id = #{turnId} AND status = 'GENERATING' AND file_ref = #{fileRef}
UPDATE tutor_turn SET status = 'FAILED', failure_code = 'TABLET_CANCELLED', failure_message = '已取消等待平板作答', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE AND turn_id = #{turnId} AND status = 'WAITING_ANSWER'
